description:
Presidential Secretariat - Removal of Hon. Anuruddha Ranasinghe Arachchige Roshan, Member of Parliament from the following Portfolios
(i) Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs
(ii) Minister of Irrigation
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically names an individual (Honourable Anuruddha Ranasinghe Arachchige Roshan, Member of Parliament) and announces his removal from ministerial portfolios. However, it only lists the general portfolio titles ("Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs" and "Minister of Irrigation") without providing any detailed descriptions of responsibilities, duties, or subject matter areas within these portfolios. This fits the definition of Type 2 (People Gazette) as it focuses on government personnel changes with basic titles only.
